code: def find_duplicates(lst): return list({x for x in lst if lst.count(x)>1})
def is_palindrome(s): s=''.join(c.lower() for c in s if c.isalnum()); return s==s[::-1]
def transpose(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m)]
def fizzbuzz(): return ['FizzBuzz' if i%15==0 else 'Fizz' if i%3==0 else 'Buzz' if i%5==0 else str(i) for i in range(1,101)]

def fibonacci(n):
 a,b=0,1
 r=[]
 for _ in range(n): r.append(a); a,b=b,a+b
 return r
def caesar(t,s): return ''.join(chr((ord(c)-b+s)%26+b)if(b:=65 if c.isupper()else 97 if c.islower()else 0)else c for c in t)
def rle_encode(s): return [(k,sum(1 for _ in g))for k,g in __import__('itertools').groupby(s)]if s else[]
